call_recover_short_sleep2: {1} of sleep is not enough to train hard on. Rest today and get to bed early.

cue_ab_crunch_machine_1: Curl your ribcage toward your pelvis rather than pulling arms.
cue_ab_crunch_machine_2: Pause in full crunch contraction and control the return.
cue_ab_roller_1: Tuck pelvis under and brace abs before rolling forward.
cue_ab_roller_2: Roll only as far as your lower back stays flat, then pull back.
cue_ab_roller_mistake: Letting the hips sag and arching the lower back.
cue_air_bike_1: Keep shoulder blades lifted and rotate ribs, not elbows.
cue_air_bike_2: Extend the opposite leg cleanly on each twist.
cue_air_bike_mistake: Rushing fast and pulling on the neck.
cue_alternating_db_curl_1: Supinate your palm upward as you curl one arm at a time.
cue_alternating_db_curl_2: Finish lowering one arm before starting the next.
cue_alternating_db_curl_mistake: Twisting the torso with every rep.
cue_alternating_db_shoulder_press_1: Squeeze glutes and abs so your torso stays still.
cue_alternating_db_shoulder_press_2: Press one arm overhead while stabilizing the other.
cue_alternating_db_shoulder_press_mistak: Leaning side to side with each rep.
cue_alternating_hammer_curl_1: Keep thumbs pointing up throughout the rep.
cue_alternating_hammer_curl_2: Control the lowering phase to load the forearms.
cue_alternating_hammer_curl_mistake: Swinging the shoulder forward at the top.
cue_archer_pull_up_1: Take a wide grip and pull toward one hand.
cue_archer_pull_up_2: Keep the other arm straight along the bar, then switch sides.
cue_archer_pull_up_mistake: Twisting the body or bending the straight arm.
cue_archer_push_up_1: Set the hands very wide and lower toward one hand.
cue_archer_push_up_2: Keep the other arm straight, press up, then switch sides.
cue_archer_push_up_mistake: Turning the hips or bending the straight arm.
cue_arnold_press_1: Start with palms facing you at upper chest height.
cue_arnold_press_2: Rotate wrists outward smoothly as you press overhead.
cue_arnold_press_mistake: Rushing the rotation or slamming weights together.
cue_australian_chin_up_1: Pull the chest to the bar with palms facing you.
cue_australian_chin_up_2: Keep the elbows close and the body in one line.
cue_australian_chin_up_mistake: Jerking up with the hips instead of the arms.
cue_australian_pull_up_1: Pull the chest to the bar with the body in one line.
cue_australian_pull_up_2: Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
cue_australian_pull_up_mistake: Letting the hips sag as you pull.
cue_back_extension_1: Lift until the body is in a straight line.
cue_back_extension_2: Squeeze the glutes and lower slowly.
cue_back_extension_mistake: Swinging up and arching the lower back.
cue_back_lever_tuck_1: Keep the arms straight and open the shoulders gently.
cue_back_lever_tuck_2: Tuck the knees and hold the body steady.
cue_back_lever_tuck_mistake: Forcing the shoulders into a deep stretch.
cue_back_squat_1: Brace the core and keep the bar over the mid-foot.
cue_back_squat_2: Sit down between the hips and drive up through the whole foot.
cue_back_squat_mistake: Letting the knees cave in or the chest drop.
cue_band_assisted_pull_up_1: Loop a band over the bar and put one foot or knee in it.
cue_band_assisted_pull_up_2: Pull the chest to the bar and lower slowly to straight arms.
cue_band_assisted_pull_up_mistake: Dropping fast and bouncing out of the band.
cue_band_calf_raise_1: Loop the band around the ball of your foot while seated.
cue_band_calf_raise_2: Press toes forward against tension and return slowly.
cue_band_calf_raise_mistake: Snapping the foot back without control.
cue_band_chest_press_1: Anchor the band behind you and press straight out.
cue_band_chest_press_2: Keep the shoulders down and return slowly.
cue_band_curl_1: Stand on the band and keep the elbows pinned.
cue_band_curl_mistake: Swinging the torso to stretch the band.
cue_band_dorsiflexion_1: Anchor the band and pull the toes toward the shin.
cue_band_dorsiflexion_2: Move the foot only, keeping the leg still.
cue_band_dorsiflexion_mistake: Rocking the whole leg to move the band.
cue_band_external_rotation_1: Pin elbow to your side at 90 degrees (tuck a towel if helpful).
cue_band_external_rotation_2: Rotate forearm outward slowly without moving the elbow.
cue_band_external_rotation_mistake: Twisting the torso or drifting the elbow away.
cue_band_good_morning_1: Loop band under feet and across upper back (never neck).
cue_band_good_morning_2: Push hips back with a flat spine, then squeeze glutes up.
cue_band_good_morning_mistake: Rounding the upper back under band pull.
cue_band_hip_adduction_1: Pull the leg inward against the band, hips level.
cue_band_hip_adduction_2: Control the return and keep the torso still.
cue_band_hip_adduction_mistake: Leaning to the side to move the leg.
cue_band_lateral_raise_1: Stand on the center of the band with soft knees.
cue_band_lateral_raise_2: Raise arms out to the sides against steady tension.
cue_band_lateral_raise_mistake: Letting the band snap your hands back down.
cue_band_leg_curl_1: Anchor the band and curl the heel toward the glutes.
cue_band_leg_curl_2: Control the return and keep the hips still.
cue_band_leg_curl_mistake: Letting the hips swing to move the band.
cue_band_overhead_triceps_1: Anchor the band under your rear foot in a staggered stance.
cue_band_overhead_triceps_2: Keep elbows close to your head and extend smoothly.
cue_band_overhead_triceps_mistake: Arching your back or flaring elbows wide.
cue_band_pull_apart_1: Pull the band apart at chest height with straight arms.
cue_band_pull_apart_mistake: Shrugging the shoulders as you pull.
cue_band_row_1: Sit tall and pull the band to the lower ribs.
cue_band_row_2: Squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
cue_band_row_mistake: Leaning back to pull the band.
cue_band_shoulder_press_1: Stand on the band with elbows tucked slightly forward.
cue_band_shoulder_press_2: Press overhead cleanly without arching the lower back.
cue_band_skull_crusher_1: Anchor band behind the bench and keep upper arms vertical.
cue_band_skull_crusher_2: Extend elbows cleanly without moving upper arms.
cue_band_skull_crusher_mistake: Letting upper arms drift toward your knees.
cue_band_squat_1: Stand on the band shoulder-width and loop ends at shoulders.
cue_band_squat_2: Sit down smoothly and drive knees out against tension.
cue_band_squat_mistake: Letting knees cave inward as you stand.
cue_band_upright_row_1: Stand on the band with hands shoulder-width apart.
cue_band_upright_row_2: Lead with elbows up to chest level, keeping wrists straight.
cue_barbell_ab_rollout_1: Kneel behind a barbell with round plates and brace hard.
cue_barbell_ab_rollout_2: Roll out under control keeping arms straight, then pull with abs.
cue_barbell_ab_rollout_mistake: Sitting hips back first instead of leading with hips and chest.
cue_barbell_calf_raise_1: Rest bar across upper traps and stand on a plate or block.
cue_barbell_calf_raise_2: Pause for 1 second at both the bottom stretch and top squeeze.
cue_barbell_calf_raise_mistake: Bouncing up and down without full range.
cue_barbell_curl_1: Keep the elbows at the sides and curl with control.
cue_barbell_curl_mistake: Rocking the torso to lift the bar.
cue_barbell_floor_press_1: Lower until the backs of your upper arms touch the floor.
cue_barbell_floor_press_2: Pause briefly without relaxing tension, then press.
cue_barbell_floor_press_mistake: Bouncing your elbows hard off the floor.
cue_barbell_glute_bridge_1: Lie flat on the floor with bar padded over your hip crease.
cue_barbell_glute_bridge_2: Drive through heels and squeeze glutes at full hip lock.
cue_barbell_glute_bridge_mistake: Hyperextending the lower back at the top.
cue_barbell_hack_squat_1: Stand in front of the bar and grip behind your thighs.
cue_barbell_hack_squat_2: Keep chest proud and drive knees forward as you squat.
cue_barbell_hack_squat_mistake: Letting the upper back round forward.
cue_barbell_lunge_1: Step forward cleanly with torso tall and core braced.
cue_barbell_lunge_2: Lower until both knees bend near 90 degrees, then push back.
cue_barbell_lunge_mistake: Letting the front knee collapse inward.
cue_barbell_pullover_1: Grip shoulder-width with a soft bend in the elbows.
cue_barbell_pullover_2: Lower behind your head under control, then pull over chest.
cue_barbell_pullover_mistake: Dropping too far and straining the shoulders.
cue_barbell_row_1: Hinge forward with a flat back and pull to the lower ribs.
cue_barbell_row_2: Keep the elbows close and squeeze the shoulder blades.
cue_barbell_row_mistake: Standing up with each rep or rounding the back.
cue_barbell_shrug_1: Keep arms straight and elevate shoulders straight toward ears.
cue_barbell_shrug_2: Hold at the top for a second before lowering slowly.
cue_barbell_side_bend_1: Place a light bar across traps and brace hips steady.
cue_barbell_side_bend_2: Tilt strictly side to side without twisting.
cue_barbell_side_bend_mistake: Leaning forward or using heavy momentum.
cue_barbell_step_up_1: Plant your full foot on the box and lean slightly forward.
cue_barbell_step_up_2: Push through the elevated heel without bouncing off the floor.
cue_barbell_step_up_mistake: Pushing off hard with the trailing foot.
cue_barbell_walking_lunge_1: Keep chest upright and take controlled, hip-width steps.
cue_barbell_walking_lunge_2: Drive smoothly through the front foot into the next step.
cue_barbell_walking_lunge_mistake: Walking on a tightrope and losing balance.
cue_battle_ropes_1: Sit into an athletic quarter-squat with chest up.
cue_battle_ropes_2: Send alternating waves down the ropes using shoulders and core.
cue_battle_ropes_mistake: Standing upright or letting shoulders hunch forward.
cue_behind_back_shrug_1: Hold the bar behind your glutes with chest tall.
cue_behind_back_shrug_2: Shrug straight up and squeeze the upper traps.
cue_behind_back_shrug_mistake: Bending the elbows or leaning forward.
cue_bench_dip_1: Keep torso close to the bench with shoulders down.
cue_bench_dip_2: Lower until upper arms are parallel to the floor.
cue_bench_dip_mistake: Rolling shoulders forward or dropping too deep.
cue_bench_press_1: Plant the feet and keep the shoulder blades squeezed together.
cue_bench_press_2: Lower the bar to the mid-chest and press up in a line.
cue_bench_press_mistake: Bouncing the bar or lifting the hips off the bench.
cue_bent_leg_bench_dip_1: Keep the elbows pointing back and close to the body.
cue_bent_leg_bench_dip_2: Lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
cue_bent_leg_bench_dip_mistake: Flaring the elbows out or dropping too deep.
cue_bent_over_cable_rear_fly_1: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding opposite low cables.
cue_bent_over_cable_rear_fly_2: Sweep arms out to the sides squeezing the rear delts.
cue_bent_over_cable_rear_fly_mistake: Rising up out of the hip hinge.
cue_bicep_curl_1: Keep the elbows pinned at your sides.
cue_bicep_curl_2: Curl up and lower slowly under control.
cue_bicep_curl_machine_1: Align your elbow joints with the machine's pivot axis.
cue_bicep_curl_machine_2: Curl smoothly and avoid slamming the stack.
cue_bicep_curl_machine_mistake: Lifting elbows off the arm pad.
cue_bicep_curl_mistake: Swinging the torso to lift the weight.
cue_biceps_wall_stretch_1: Place the palm on a wall behind you with the arm straight.
cue_biceps_wall_stretch_2: Turn the body slowly away until the arm feels long.
cue_biceps_wall_stretch_mistake: Cranking the shoulder into a sharp pull.
cue_bicycle_crunch_1: Rotate the ribs toward the opposite knee.
cue_bicycle_crunch_2: Move slowly and keep the lower back down.
cue_bicycle_crunch_mistake: Pulling on the neck and rushing the reps.
cue_bird_dog_1: Reach the opposite arm and leg long, hips level.
cue_bird_dog_2: Move slowly and keep the spine still.
cue_bird_dog_mistake: Rotating the hips as the leg lifts.
cue_bodyweight_walking_lunge_1: Keep torso upright and step forward at hip width.
cue_bodyweight_walking_lunge_2: Lower back knee softly before pushing through front heel.

cue_heel_touches_1: Lift shoulders slightly off the mat and keep chin neutral.
cue_heel_touches_2: Slide side to side reaching each hand toward the same heel.
cue_heel_walk_1: Walk on your heels with the toes pulled up.
cue_heel_walk_2: Take short, steady steps and keep upright.
cue_heel_walk_mistake: Letting the toes drop as you tire.
cue_high_cable_curl_1: Stand centered between high pulleys with upper arms parallel to floor.
cue_high_cable_curl_2: Curl handles toward your ears without dropping elbows.
cue_high_cable_curl_mistake: Dropping upper arms as you fatigue.
cue_high_row_machine_1: Brace chest against the pad and reach tall at the top.
cue_high_row_machine_2: Pull handles down and back, squeezing your lats.
cue_high_row_machine_mistake: Leaning away from the pad to finish.
cue_hip_bridge_1: Push through your heels and squeeze the glutes at the top.
cue_hip_bridge_2: Stop when hips and knees line up.
cue_hip_bridge_mistake: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.
cue_hip_flexor_stretch_1: Kneel on one knee and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
cue_hip_flexor_stretch_2: Shift the hips forward until the front of the hip feels long.
cue_hip_flexor_stretch_mistake: Leaning back instead of tucking the pelvis.
cue_hip_thrust_1: Chin tucked, drive through the heels, ribs down.
cue_hip_thrust_2: Squeeze the glutes hard at the top.
cue_hip_thrust_mistake: Overarching the lower back at the top.
cue_hollow_hold_1: Press the lower back into the floor.
cue_hollow_hold_2: Lift the shoulders and legs, arms by the ears.
cue_hollow_hold_mistake: Letting the lower back arch off the floor.
cue_incline_barbell_tricep_ext_1: Keep upper arms pointed slightly back on the incline bench.
cue_incline_barbell_tricep_ext_2: Lower behind your head for a deep triceps stretch.
cue_incline_barbell_tricep_ext_mistake: Moving upper arms forward and back.
cue_incline_bench_press_1: Set the bench to about 30 degrees with the shoulder blades back.
cue_incline_bench_press_2: Lower the bar to the upper chest and press up over the shoulders.
cue_incline_bench_press_mistake: Lifting the hips or letting the bar drift toward the face.
cue_incline_cable_chest_press_1: Plant shoulder blades on the incline bench.
cue_incline_cable_chest_press_2: Press up and slightly inward over the upper chest.
cue_incline_cable_chest_press_mistake: Letting elbows drop below the bench line.
cue_incline_cable_fly_1: Set pulleys low and keep a slight elbow bend.
cue_incline_cable_fly_2: Bring hands together over your upper chest and pause.
cue_incline_chest_press_machine_1: Adjust the seat so handles align with upper chest.
cue_incline_chest_press_machine_2: Press smoothly without locking elbows harshly.
cue_incline_chest_press_machine_mistake: Letting shoulders roll forward off the backrest.
cue_incline_db_curl_1: Let the arms hang behind the body and curl up.
cue_incline_db_curl_2: Keep the elbows still and the shoulders back.
cue_incline_db_fly_1: Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows as arms open wide.
cue_incline_db_fly_2: Feel a chest stretch at shoulder level, then hug back up.
cue_incline_db_fly_mistake: Turning the fly into a press or dropping too low.
cue_incline_db_front_raise_1: Rest your back firmly against the incline pad.
cue_incline_db_front_raise_2: Lift smoothly to eye level and control the descent.
cue_incline_db_front_raise_mistake: Peeling your upper back off the bench.
cue_incline_db_press_1: Set the bench at a low incline and keep the shoulder blades back.
cue_incline_db_press_2: Press the dumbbells up and slightly together.
cue_incline_db_press_mistake: Setting the bench too steep so the shoulders take over.
cue_incline_diamond_knee_push_up_1: Make a diamond with your hands under the chest.
cue_incline_diamond_knee_push_up_2: Keep the elbows close and the body in one line.
cue_incline_diamond_knee_push_up_mistake: Letting the elbows flare or the hips sag.
cue_incline_hammer_curl_1: Let arms hang vertically behind your torso on the incline.
cue_incline_hammer_curl_2: Curl with neutral palms without pulling elbows forward.
cue_incline_hollow_plank_1: Tuck the tailbone and press the floor away.
cue_incline_hollow_plank_2: Ribs down, belly braced, body in one line.
cue_incline_hollow_plank_mistake: Letting the hips pike up or the lower back arch.
cue_incline_push_up_1: Put the hands on a bench or table, body in one straight line.
cue_incline_push_up_2: Lower the chest to the edge and press back up.
cue_incline_push_up_mistake: Sagging hips or reaching with the chin.
cue_incline_reverse_plank_1: Press the hips up until the body is one line.
cue_incline_reverse_plank_2: Keep the chest open and the neck relaxed.
cue_incline_reverse_plank_mistake: Sinking the hips toward the floor.
cue_inverted_row_1: Hold a rigid plank from heels to head under the bar.
cue_inverted_row_2: Pull chest to the bar and squeeze shoulder blades together.
cue_inverted_row_mistake: Sagging the hips or leading with your chin.
cue_iso_row_machine_1: Keep chest anchored on the pad and spine neutral.
cue_iso_row_machine_2: Drive elbows behind you and control the return.
cue_iso_row_machine_mistake: Twisting the torso on single-arm reps.
cue_jackknife_sit_up_1: Start long on the floor with arms overhead.
cue_jackknife_sit_up_2: Lift torso and straight legs together to meet in the middle.
cue_jackknife_sit_up_mistake: Bending knees sharply or slamming back down.
cue_jm_press_1: Use a shoulder-width grip and let elbows drift slightly forward.
cue_jm_press_2: Lower the bar toward your chin/upper chest, then drive up.
cue_jm_press_mistake: Dropping elbows wide like a flat bench press.
cue_jump_rope_1: Turn the rope from your wrists, elbows tucked at sides.
cue_jump_rope_2: Stay light on the balls of your feet with tiny bounces.
cue_jump_rope_mistake: Swinging the whole arms or jumping too high.
cue_jump_squat_1: Quarter-to-half squat smoothly, then explode straight up.
cue_jump_squat_2: Land softly on mid-foot absorbing the drop into the next rep.
cue_jumping_jacks_1: Land softly on the balls of your feet.
cue_jumping_jacks_2: Keep your arms moving in a full, easy arc.
cue_jumping_jacks_mistake: Stomping down hard and locking the knees.
cue_kb_alternating_press_1: Clean both bells to rack position with tight glutes and abs.
cue_kb_alternating_press_2: Press one overhead while keeping the other anchored.
cue_kb_alternating_press_mistake: Leaning back to push the weight.
cue_kb_alternating_row_1: Hinge with a neutral back and brace your core.
cue_kb_alternating_row_2: Row one bell toward your hip while lowering the other.
cue_kb_alternating_row_mistake: Rounding the spine or jerking upward.
cue_kb_arnold_press_1: Start in the rack position with palm facing inward.
cue_kb_arnold_press_2: Rotate wrist outward as you press the bell overhead.
cue_kb_arnold_press_mistake: Arching the lower back during lockout.
cue_kb_clean_1: Hinge back, then pull the bell close and into the rack.
cue_kb_clean_2: Keep the bell close to the body.
cue_kb_clean_mistake: Letting the bell swing out and bang the forearm.
cue_kb_deadlift_1: Hinge back with a flat spine and the bell between your feet.
cue_kb_deadlift_2: Stand tall by driving the hips forward.
cue_kb_deadlift_mistake: Rounding the back to reach the bell.
cue_kb_double_front_squat_1: Rest bells in the front rack with elbows tucked forward.
cue_kb_double_front_squat_2: Sit deep between your heels keeping chest tall.
cue_kb_double_front_squat_mistake: Letting elbows drop forward and rounding upper back.
cue_kb_figure_8_1: Hold a quarter-squat hinge with flat back and tight core.
cue_kb_figure_8_2: Pass the bell smoothly between legs from hand to hand.
cue_kb_figure_8_mistake: Rounding the lower back while reaching down.
cue_kb_floor_press_1: Keep wrist straight and elbow tucked at 45 degrees.
cue_kb_floor_press_2: Pause with triceps on the floor, then press straight up.
cue_kb_floor_press_mistake: Flaring the elbow out to 90 degrees.
cue_kb_halo_1: Circle the bell close to the head with the ribs down.
cue_kb_halo_2: Keep the elbows tucked and move slowly.
cue_kb_halo_mistake: Leaning back as the bell passes behind the head.
cue_kb_one_arm_swing_1: Hinge at the hips and keep shoulders square—no twisting.
cue_kb_one_arm_swing_2: Snap hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
cue_kb_one_arm_swing_mistake: Squatting down or lifting with the front shoulder.
cue_kb_pistol_squat_1: Hold the kettlebell out front or racked as a counterbalance.
cue_kb_pistol_squat_2: Sit smoothly onto the working heel and drive straight up.
cue_kb_pistol_squat_mistake: Collapsing the knee inward at the bottom.
cue_kb_press_1: Brace the core and press the bell straight overhead.
cue_kb_press_2: Finish with the biceps by the ear and the ribs down.
cue_kb_press_mistake: Leaning back to push the bell up.
cue_kb_renegade_row_1: Set feet wider than shoulder width in a strong plank.
cue_kb_renegade_row_2: Row one bell to your hip while keeping hips square to floor.
cue_kb_renegade_row_mistake: Rotating or hiking one hip upward with each row.
cue_kb_row_1: Hinge forward with a flat back and row the bell to the hip.
cue_kb_row_2: Squeeze the shoulder blade back at the top.
cue_kb_row_mistake: Twisting the torso to lift the bell.
cue_kb_seated_press_1: Sit tall with core braced and wrist straight.
cue_kb_seated_press_2: Press straight overhead until bicep aligns by your ear.
cue_kb_seated_press_mistake: Letting the kettlebell pull your wrist backward.
cue_kb_snatch_1: Swing from the hips and punch the bell overhead.
cue_kb_snatch_2: Keep the arm close and lock out the elbow.
cue_kb_snatch_mistake: Pulling with the arm and hitting the wrist.
cue_kb_sumo_deadlift_1: Take a wide stance with the toes out and the back flat.
cue_kb_sumo_deadlift_2: Drive the floor away and stand tall.
cue_kb_sumo_deadlift_mistake: Rounding the back or letting the knees cave in.
cue_kb_sumo_high_pull_1: Stand wide, hinge down with flat back, and drive hips up.
cue_kb_sumo_high_pull_2: Pull elbows high to chin height as hips finish locking.
cue_kb_sumo_high_pull_mistake: Pulling only with the arms before hips extend.
cue_kb_swing_1: Hinge the hips back and snap them forward.
cue_kb_swing_2: Let the arms swing; the hips drive the bell.
cue_kb_swing_mistake: Squatting the swing or lifting with the arms.
cue_kb_thruster_1: Hold the bell in rack position and squat to parallel.
cue_kb_thruster_2: Drive smoothly out of the squat directly into an overhead press.
cue_kb_thruster_mistake: Pausing at the top of the squat before pressing.
cue_kb_windmill_1: Keep your eyes on the bell and hinge toward the front leg.
cue_kb_windmill_2: Slide the hand down the leg while the arm stays straight.
cue_kb_windmill_mistake: Bending the arm or rushing the hinge.
cue_knee_push_up_1: Keep a straight line from the knees to the head.
cue_knee_push_up_2: Lower the chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
cue_knee_push_up_mistake: Sagging the hips or flaring the elbows wide.
cue_knee_scapular_push_up_1: Keep the arms straight and move only the shoulder blades.
cue_knee_scapular_push_up_2: Push the floor away to spread them, then squeeze them back.
cue_knee_scapular_push_up_mistake: Bending the elbows instead of moving the shoulders.
cue_kneeling_high_pulley_row_1: Brace abs while kneeling and let lats stretch overhead.
cue_kneeling_high_pulley_row_2: Pull handles toward your upper ribs, elbows tight.
cue_l_sit_1: Press the shoulders down and lock the arms.
cue_l_sit_2: Keep the legs straight and squeezed together.
cue_l_sit_mistake: Shrugging the shoulders and bending the knees.
cue_l_sit_pull_up_1: Hang and lift the straight legs to hip height.
cue_l_sit_pull_up_2: Hold the legs there while you pull the chin over the bar.
cue_l_sit_pull_up_mistake: Letting the legs drop as you pull.
cue_landmine_one_arm_row_1: Stagger your stance and rest your free hand on your thigh.
cue_landmine_one_arm_row_2: Drive the elbow back toward your hip without twisting.
cue_landmine_one_arm_row_mistake: Rounding the lower back or rotating the torso.
cue_landmine_press_1: Brace your core and lean slightly into the bar angle.
cue_landmine_press_2: Press up and forward along the natural arc.
cue_landmine_press_mistake: Twisting the torso or shrugging the shoulder.
cue_landmine_twist_1: Keep arms nearly straight and brace abs with soft knees.
cue_landmine_twist_2: Rotate the bar in an arc from hip to hip using your core.
cue_landmine_twist_mistake: Swinging from the arms while the hips flop side to side.
cue_lat_pulldown_1: Pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows toward the floor.
cue_lat_pulldown_2: Sit tall and keep the shoulders down.
cue_lat_pulldown_mistake: Leaning far back and yanking the bar down.
cue_lat_stretch_1: Reach one arm overhead and lean to the opposite side.
cue_lat_stretch_2: Keep both feet planted and the hips level.
cue_lateral_raise_1: Lead with the elbows and lift to shoulder height.
cue_lateral_raise_2: Use light weights and lower slowly.
cue_lateral_raise_mistake: Swinging the weights with the torso.
cue_leg_curl_1: Keep the hips pressed down and curl the heels toward the glutes.
cue_leg_curl_2: Lower slowly through the full range.
cue_leg_curl_mistake: Lifting the hips off the pad.
cue_leg_extension_1: Set the pad above the ankles and extend smoothly.
cue_leg_extension_2: Squeeze the quads at the top and lower slowly.
cue_leg_extension_mistake: Swinging the weight up with momentum.
cue_leg_press_1: Keep the lower back and hips pressed into the seat.
cue_leg_press_2: Lower until the knees reach a deep angle, then press.
cue_leg_press_calf_raise_1: Place balls of your feet near the bottom edge of the sled.
cue_leg_press_calf_raise_2: Keep knees softly unlocked and press through full ankle range.
cue_leg_press_calf_raise_mistake: Bouncing fast without pausing at stretch and peak.
cue_leg_press_mistake: Letting the hips curl off the seat at the bottom.
cue_leverage_shoulder_press_1: Set seat height so handles begin at chin level.
cue_leverage_shoulder_press_2: Keep back pressed into the pad and push evenly.
cue_leverage_shoulder_press_mistake: Shrugging traps at the top or bouncing off stops.
cue_low_cable_tricep_ext_1: Face away from the low pulley with a staggered stance.
cue_low_cable_tricep_ext_2: Keep elbows close to your head and press forward-up.
cue_low_cable_tricep_ext_mistake: Arching the lower back under heavy load.
cue_lunge_1: Take a long step and drop the back knee straight down.
cue_lunge_2: Keep the torso upright and the front foot flat.
cue_lunge_mistake: Letting the front knee collapse inward.
cue_lying_leg_raise_1: Grip the bench behind your head and press lower back flat.
cue_lying_leg_raise_2: Raise straight legs to vertical and lower slowly without arching.
cue_lying_leg_raise_mistake: Letting legs drop below bench level with an arched back.
cue_lying_t_bar_row_1: Keep your chest planted on the pad throughout.
cue_lying_t_bar_row_2: Pull elbows back and squeeze the mid-back.
cue_lying_t_bar_row_mistake: Lifting your chest off the pad to finish the pull.
cue_mixed_grip_chin_up_1: Place one palm facing you and one facing away; switch sets.
cue_mixed_grip_chin_up_2: Pull smoothly until chin clears the bar.
cue_mountain_climber_1: Keep the shoulders over the wrists and the core braced.
cue_mountain_climber_2: Drive the knees in with a steady rhythm.
cue_muscle_up_1: Pull explosively and lean back over the bar.
cue_muscle_up_2: Lead with the chest and press out above the bar.
cue_muscle_up_mistake: Pulling with straight hips and arms too long.
cue_narrow_leg_press_1: Place feet lower and closer on the sled, heels planted.
cue_narrow_leg_press_2: Lower until knees reach full comfortable bend without lifting hips.
cue_narrow_leg_press_mistake: Locking knees violently or lifting lower back off the pad.
cue_narrow_stance_squat_1: Place feet hip-width or narrower and keep torso upright.
cue_narrow_stance_squat_2: Let knees track over toes and drive up through midfoot.
cue_narrow_stance_squat_mistake: Heels lifting off the floor at the bottom.
cue_neck_side_stretch_1: Tilt your ear toward your shoulder and keep the shoulder down.
cue_neck_side_stretch_2: Let the weight of the head do the work.
cue_neck_side_stretch_mistake: Pulling the head hard with the hand.
cue_negative_pull_up_1: Jump to the top and lower for a slow count of five.
cue_negative_pull_up_2: Keep the body tight and the shoulders down.
cue_negative_pull_up_mistake: Dropping fast instead of controlling the descent.
cue_neutral_grip_db_press_1: Hold palms facing each other and tuck elbows at 30 degrees.
cue_neutral_grip_db_press_2: Lower deep beside the chest and press straight up.
cue_neutral_grip_db_press_mistake: Dropping shoulders forward at the top.
cue_neutral_grip_pull_up_1: Grip the parallel handles with the palms facing each other.
cue_neutral_grip_pull_up_2: Pull the elbows down to the ribs until the chin clears the handles.
cue_neutral_grip_pull_up_mistake: Cutting the bottom short instead of reaching straight arms.
cue_nordic_curl_1: Keep the hips extended and lower from the knees as one line.
cue_nordic_curl_2: Lower as slowly as you can, then push off to return.
cue_overhead_cable_triceps_extension_1: Keep the elbows high and pointed forward.
cue_overhead_cable_triceps_extension_2: Straighten the arms fully and return slowly.
cue_overhead_cable_triceps_extension_mis: Letting the elbows flare out wide.
cue_overhead_db_tricep_ext_1: Cup the top plate of one dumbbell overhead, elbows tucked.
cue_overhead_db_tricep_ext_2: Lower slowly behind your head and press straight up.
cue_overhead_db_tricep_ext_mistake: Letting elbows flare wide or arching the lower back.
cue_overhead_press_1: Squeeze the glutes and keep the ribs down.
cue_overhead_press_2: Press the bar straight up, head moving through at the end.
cue_overhead_press_mistake: Leaning back to push the weight up.
cue_overhead_squat_1: Lock the bar directly over mid-foot with active shoulders.
cue_overhead_squat_2: Sit straight down between your hips keeping the bar stacked.
cue_overhead_squat_mistake: Letting the bar drift forward of your toes.
cue_pallof_press_1: Press the handle out and resist the cable pulling you.
cue_pallof_press_2: Keep the hips and shoulders square.
cue_pallof_press_mistake: Letting the torso rotate toward the cable.
cue_pec_deck_1: Sit tall with the shoulder blades back against the pad.
cue_pec_deck_2: Bring the arms together and squeeze the chest.
cue_pec_deck_mistake: Rounding the shoulders forward at the end.
cue_pigeon_stretch_1: Bring one shin forward and slide the back leg straight behind you.
cue_pigeon_stretch_2: Fold over the front leg and breathe out slowly.
cue_pigeon_stretch_mistake: Letting the hips twist off to one side.
cue_pike_push_up_1: Hips high, head moving down between the hands.
cue_pike_push_up_2: Press back up until the arms are straight.
cue_pike_push_up_mistake: Turning it into a regular push-up with low hips.
cue_pistol_squat_1: Reach the arms forward for balance and keep the heel down.
cue_pistol_squat_2: Lower under control with the free leg straight.
cue_pistol_squat_mistake: Dropping the last part and losing control.
cue_plank_1: Squeeze the glutes and brace the belly.
cue_plank_2: Keep the head in line with the spine.
cue_plank_mistake: Letting the hips sag or rise.
cue_plank_shoulder_taps_1: Squeeze your glutes and keep the hips level.
cue_plank_shoulder_taps_2: Spread your feet wider to stay steady.
cue_plank_shoulder_taps_mistake: Rocking the hips side to side with every tap.
cue_plate_front_raise_1: Grip the sides of a weight plate like a steering wheel.
cue_plate_front_raise_2: Raise to eye level and lower under control.
cue_plate_front_raise_mistake: Swinging the plate with lower-back momentum.
cue_plyo_push_up_1: Lower under control, then explode upward off the floor.
cue_plyo_push_up_2: Land with soft elbows straight into the next rep.
cue_plyo_push_up_mistake: Landing stiff-armed or letting hips sag.
cue_power_clean_1: Keep bar close off the floor, then extend hips explosively.
cue_power_clean_2: Whip elbows fast under the bar to catch on front shoulders.
cue_power_clean_mistake: Pulling early with the arms instead of extending hips.
cue_preacher_barbell_curl_1: Tuck armpits snugly over the top of the preacher pad.
cue_preacher_barbell_curl_2: Lower almost to full extension without snapping the elbow.
cue_preacher_barbell_curl_mistake: Lifting hips off the seat to force the weight up.
cue_preacher_curl_1: Keep the upper arms flat on the pad.
cue_preacher_curl_2: Lower slowly until the arm is almost straight.
cue_preacher_curl_mistake: Dropping the weight and lifting the shoulders.
cue_preacher_hammer_curl_1: Hold dumbbells neutrally (palms facing each other) on the pad.
cue_preacher_hammer_curl_2: Lower slowly and stop just before full elbow lockout.
cue_preacher_hammer_curl_mistake: Bouncing out of the bottom position.
cue_pseudo_planche_push_up_1: Place the hands by the hips with fingers pointing back.
cue_pseudo_planche_push_up_2: Lean forward and keep the body in one line.
cue_pseudo_planche_push_up_mistake: Keeping the shoulders over the hands.
cue_pull_up_1: Start from a full hang and lead with the chest.
cue_pull_up_2: Pull until the chin is over the bar, then lower slowly.
cue_pull_up_mistake: Kipping or cutting the range short.
cue_push_press_1: Dip knees slightly with torso upright, then drive violently.
cue_push_press_2: Punch the bar overhead as hips and knees lock out.
cue_push_press_mistake: Dropping the chest forward during the dip.
cue_push_up_1: Keep the body in one line from head to heels.
cue_push_up_2: Lower the chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
cue_push_up_mistake: Sagging the hips or flaring the elbows wide.
cue_quad_stretch_1: Pull your heel toward your glute and keep the knees together.
cue_quad_stretch_2: Stand tall and tuck the pelvis slightly under.
cue_quad_stretch_mistake: Arching the lower back to pull the foot higher.
cue_rack_pull_1: Set pins just below or at knee height and brace hard.
cue_rack_pull_2: Push hips forward to lock out without hyperextending.
cue_rack_pull_mistake: Bouncing the bar off the safety pins.
cue_rear_delt_db_fly_1: Hinge forward with a flat back and the dumbbells hanging.
cue_rear_delt_db_fly_2: Raise the arms out to the sides, leading with the elbows.
cue_reverse_barbell_curl_1: Grip overhand (palms down) and keep wrists straight.
cue_reverse_barbell_curl_2: Curl smoothly to work brachioradialis and forearms.
cue_reverse_barbell_curl_mistake: Cocking wrists back or swinging the torso.
cue_reverse_barbell_wrist_curl_1: Rest forearms on the bench with palms down, wrists over edge.
cue_reverse_barbell_wrist_curl_2: Extend knuckles upward and lower smoothly.
cue_reverse_barbell_wrist_curl_mistake: Lifting your forearms off the bench.
cue_reverse_crunch_1: Keep knees bent at 90 degrees and curl tailbone off the floor.
cue_reverse_crunch_2: Lower hips slowly until toes lightly tap or hover.
cue_reverse_crunch_mistake: Dropping legs quickly and arching your lower back.
cue_reverse_db_curl_1: Hold dumbbells with palms facing backward/downward.
cue_reverse_db_curl_2: Curl up with elbows fixed at your sides.
cue_reverse_db_curl_mistake: Letting wrists bend backward under load.
cue_reverse_grip_barbell_row_1: Grip palms up and keep elbows close to your sides.
cue_reverse_grip_barbell_row_2: Pull the bar into your lower belly and control the lower.
cue_reverse_grip_barbell_row_mistake: Rising too upright or shrugging the traps.
cue_reverse_grip_bench_dip_1: Turn the fingers toward your feet and keep the chest tall.
cue_reverse_grip_bench_dip_2: Lower under control, elbows pointing back.
cue_reverse_grip_bench_dip_mistake: Letting the shoulders roll forward at the bottom.
cue_reverse_grip_pushdown_1: Grip the straight bar with palms facing up.
cue_reverse_grip_pushdown_2: Extend fully while keeping elbows fixed by your ribs.
cue_reverse_grip_pushdown_mistake: Dropping wrists or letting elbows swing.
cue_reverse_hyperextension_1: Anchor your torso on the pad and brace your core.
cue_reverse_hyperextension_2: Lift legs with glutes and hamstrings to body level.
cue_reverse_hyperextension_mistake: Swinging the legs up using momentum.
cue_reverse_lunge_1: Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor.
cue_reverse_lunge_2: Push through the front foot to stand up again.
cue_reverse_lunge_mistake: Letting the front knee cave in.
cue_reverse_pec_deck_1: Lead with the elbows and open the arms wide.
cue_reverse_pec_deck_mistake: Shrugging and using the lower back to push.
cue_ring_dip_1: Press rings close to your hips at the top and turn rings out.
cue_ring_dip_2: Lower slowly with elbows tucked back.
cue_ring_dip_mistake: Letting arms shake out to the sides.
cue_romanian_deadlift_1: Push the hips back with soft knees and a flat back.
cue_romanian_deadlift_2: Lower until you feel the hamstrings stretch.
cue_romanian_deadlift_mistake: Bending the knees too much so it becomes a squat.
cue_rope_crunch_1: Hold the rope by your temples and keep hips stationary.
